_about: DRAFT wording options for points that need a lawyer's decision. None of this text has been approved. The statement inputs must choose one option id per topic. Any statement that contains this wording is watermarked DRAFT until the approval record in the statement inputs is complete. A null text means 'say nothing on this point'. An option may carry an evidence rule; if the registry does not support it, the build stops.

billing.label: How we bill for AI-assisted work

options.name: Time spent, no tool charge
options.text: We bill for the time our lawyers and staff spend, including time spent reviewing and correcting tool output. We do not bill for time a tool saved, and we do not add a separate charge for the tools described here.
options.short: We bill for the time our people spend, not for time a tool saved, and add no separate charge for the tools.

options.name: Time spent, per-use costs only with written approval
options.text: We bill for the time our lawyers and staff spend, including time spent reviewing and correcting tool output. We do not bill for time a tool saved. If a matter needs a tool with a per-use cost, we ask for your written approval first and bill that cost without markup.
options.short: We bill for the time our people spend, not for time a tool saved. Per-use tool costs are billed without markup and only with your written approval.

options.name: Refer to the engagement letter
options.text: How we bill for AI-assisted work on your matters is set out in your engagement letter. We do not add a charge for the tools described here unless that letter says so.
options.short: Billing for AI-assisted work is set out in your engagement letter.

options.name: Say nothing beyond the registry facts
Registry-approved tools only
options.text: We enter your confidential information only into tools that our registry approves for client confidential information.

options.name: Registry-approved tools only, with provider agreement
options.text: We enter your confidential information only into tools that our registry approves for client confidential information. Each of those tools is covered by a written agreement with its provider.

options.name: Say nothing on disclosure to courts
Tell the client first
options.text: We tell you before we use one of these tools to draft part of a court filing in your matter.

options.name: Signing attorney handles court disclosure
options.text: Where a court asks filers to disclose AI use, the attorney who signs the filing makes that disclosure and tells you.

opt_out.label: Setting your own terms or opting out

options.name: Opt out or set conditions, recorded at intake
options.text: You can tell us not to use these tools on your matters, or set conditions on their use. Write to {opt_out_role}. We record your instruction in the matter intake record and apply it to work done after we confirm receipt.
options.short: You can restrict or refuse these tools on your matters by writing to {opt_out_role}.

options.name: Short form
options.text: You can set your own terms for AI use on your matters, including no use. Write to {opt_out_role}.
options.short: You can set your own terms for AI use on your matters, including no use.

options.name: Stricter client terms govern
options.text: Where your terms are stricter than the rest of this statement, we follow your terms.
